# Lecture 03 — PMBOK Guide 7: Principles & Performance Domains

!!! abstract "At a glance"
    **Unit:** U1 · **Week 2** · **CLOs:** CLO1 ·
    **Bloom:** Understand

    The 12 principles and 8 performance domains as the course's backbone.

## Session topics & takeaways

This session covers:

1. Why PMI moved from 49 processes (PMBOK 6) to 12 principles (PMBOK 7)
2. Principle groups — stewardship, team, stakeholders, value, systems thinking, leadership, tailoring, quality, complexity, risk, adaptability, resilience
3. Stakeholders, team, development approach & life cycle, planning, project work, delivery, measurement, uncertainty
4. How domains interact on a real project
3. PMBOK 7's 'choose your tools' stance and what it means for tailoring

## Core content

### 1. From processes to principles

- Why PMI moved from 49 processes (PMBOK 6) to 12 principles (PMBOK 7)
- Principle groups — stewardship, team, stakeholders, value, systems thinking, leadership, tailoring, quality, complexity, risk, adaptability, resilience

### 2. The 8 performance domains

- Stakeholders, team, development approach & life cycle, planning, project work, delivery, measurement, uncertainty
- How domains interact on a real project

### 3. Models, methods, artifacts

- PMBOK 7's 'choose your tools' stance and what it means for tailoring
